title: DLNA media server for shared folders

clauses.text: The media server shows the person's shared media to a DLNA player on the same network, and a file plays there.

steps.do: Make a shared folder with audio or video in it (Settings, Shares, Files-mode share). On the Shares page press m (Media server) and agree to the card. On a TV or media app on the same network, look for the IYAKKI server and open a file.
steps.expect: The IYAKKI server is listed in the player, the shared folder's files are listed, and the file plays. Files outside the shared folder are not listed.
